summary: Meta AI replaced the search entry point and sits in DMs. There is no setting to remove it — the only lever is not using it.

steps.path: No off switch exists. Mitigation: use search normally and ignore the AI prompt; do not open the Meta AI thread in DMs.

whyTheyDidIt: Same playbook as WhatsApp: distribution first, consent never.

sources.label: Consumer Reports — no way to disable Meta's AI altogether
